_about: Prose figures (1 Nov 2026): amounts written in running text in Naira-billion form ('N12.9 billion', 'N9.3billion', '₦694 billion'), with a percent beside them ('N19.7billion (82.4%)', '25% ... (N116 billion)', 'N89.215 billion (or 73.10%)'), from plans and reports already in the library. The answer must be given and pass the figure and attribution checks, not refused as unverified. The decimal-comma form ('NGN29,6 billion') has no clean instance in the library (the DSA's 'N23,11 million' is a thousands slip): tests/test_prose_figures.py covers it. Part of the pre-deploy gate: uv run python evals/complex/run_open.py --file evals/prose/questions.json --out evals/prose/report.md

questions.text: According to the 2023 Citizens Accountability Report, what was the Board of Internal Revenue's budget and how much did it realise?
What were Sokoto State's total cash reserves at the end of 2023?
Which MDA had the highest total actual expenditure in 2023 according to the Citizens Accountability Report, and how much was it?
According to the 2025 Sokoto MPI report, what share of the 2025 budget went to education, and how much was that?
What was Sokoto's domestic debt stock in the MTEF 2025-2027, and what share of total debt was it?
How much was the Tamaje Water Scheme the state government commissioned?
Nawa ne kasafin Hukumar Tattara Haraji ta Jihar Sokoto (BIR) a 2023 bisa Rahoton Lissafin Kuɗi ga 'Yan Ƙasa, kuma nawa aka samu?
